lines.text: Israel did not stumble beyond recovery, and salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.
Paul hopes to save some of his own people, and says their acceptance will be light to the nations.
A wild olive shoot has been grafted in, and the root supports it, so it must not boast.
The natural branches were broken off because of unbelief, but the grafted-in branch stands by works.
God is able to graft the broken-off branches in again if they do not persist in unbelief.
